title: Resorting To Happiness
meta_description: Welcome to Resorting To Happiness! A stylish 4BR retreat with communal pool access, BBQ, \& golf cart---minutes from 30A beaches, dining \& shopping.
description_expanded:
Tucked away in the serene enclave of Inlet Beach, Resorting To Happiness offers an unparalleled blend of style, comfort, and effortless access to the best of the Emerald Coast. Mere moments from the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters of 30A and steps from the pool, this four-bedroom retreat is designed for those who seek both relaxation and adventure.

Step inside a bright, open-concept living space where chic coastal design meets modern comfort. The spacious living area, complete with a plush sectional and large-screen TV, invites you to unwind after a sun-soaked day. Gather around the dining table for elegant meals or perch at the kitchen island barstools as the chef of your group prepares fresh Gulf seafood in the fully equipped kitchen.

Each bedroom is a sanctuary of comfort, featuring plush bedding, stylish décor, and a private television---perfect for winding down in the evenings. A charming bunk nook offers flexible sleeping arrangements, ideal for kids or extra guests. With four thoughtfully designed bathrooms, everyone in your group can refresh with ease.

Outdoors, a private back porch with shaded seating and a BBQ grill set the stage for al fresco dining, while the two front porches provide the perfect spot for morning coffee or sunset cocktails. A treed common area in the backyard offers an ideal safe space for kids to play. Rinse off from the beach with the convenient outdoor shower, then head to the nearby community pool, just steps away, for a leisurely afternoon swim.

Beyond your doorstep, explore the charm of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach just minutes away, with Seaside a short scenic drive down 30A. The nearest beach access is about a mile away, and several public access points are nearby---including Camp Helen State Park, offering beach entry and ample parking.

With in-home laundry, driveway parking, and every amenity thoughtfully provided, Resorting To Happiness is more than a vacation rental---it's your exclusive gateway to the elegance of 30A. Whether you're strolling along the shoreline, indulging in fine dining, or browsing local boutiques, every moment here is infused with coastal sophistication. Your coastal escape awaits. Book now and experience the Emerald Coast in effortless style.

A 6-seater golf cart is available for effortless beach-hopping and town exploring upon receipt of a signed waiver. Please inquire in advance. If an additional golf cart is needed, it must be rented through 30A Golf Cart Rentals, the only vendor authorized by the Prominence Association. Any other rented golf carts will be required to be returned or will be towed.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips!

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach, Old Florida Fish House Restaurant

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- A 6-seater golf cart is available for effortless beach-hopping and town exploring upon receipt of a signed waiver. Please inquire in advance. If an additional golf cart is needed, it must be rented through 30A Golf Cart Rentals, the only vendor authorized by the Prominence Association. Any other rented golf carts will be required to be returned or will be towed.
- Quiet hours start at 10 PM -- Please be respectful of neighbors and keep noise levels down during this time.
- There is no smoking or vaping permitted inside the home or anywhere on the property. Violations will result in a fine, along with the cost of any necessary cleaning, deodorizing, or damage repairs. Additional fees may apply if smoke remediation is required.

Parking Details:
- Two cars can be parked in the driveway, with a possible third parked laterally.
- Street parking is not allowed.
- Security will sticker improperly parked vehicles, and if not moved, they will be booted and towed at the owner's expense. Please do not block the neighbors' driveways or park on pine straw, plant beds, or grass. Violations are subject to towing per Prominence Association by-laws.
- Overflow parking is available at the community pool a block from the home or at the pool north of 30A in the Prominence subdivision.
- The golf cart is street-legal but cannot be parked in the street. Security will sticker improperly parked carts, and if not moved, they will be booted and towed at the renter's expense. Do not block driveways or park on sidewalks, pine straw, plant beds, or grassy areas. Violations are subject to towing per Prominence Association by-laws.

This home comes with a pack n' play travel crib and a high chair available.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

STR Permit: 109482
